mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the cradle across the arches was the most worthwhile addition: it brought the separate supports together into a carrier.

leastWorthwhile.text: The repeated flips were straightforward but less engaging, and the changing frame and whale carrier names made the orientation slightly confusing.

surprise.text: The cradle assembly being named a whale carrier surprised me; its purpose wasn't clear yet.

arbitrary.text: No fitting seemed purposeless, though the alternating names for the same construction were confusing.

continue.text: I might continue to see what the carrier does, but this chapter's mostly prescribed fittings were not especially engaging on their own.
